text:
sophia: Hey — my docs PR for the batching config examples is blocked. CI preview failed and there's an unresolved runtime default mismatch: SDK snippet uses `batch_timeout_ms: 5` but the runtime logs show 10. Need runtime confirmation and a reviewer before tomorrow's point release.
docs-ci-bot: preview failed — rendering error in /docs/reference/batching.md line 42. full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1979123456
kevin: I remember we bumped the runtime default during the continuous-batching perf rollout. Pretty sure runtime default is 10 now, but the SDK kept 5 for backcompat. I'll double-check runtime config and post exact commit.
anya: CI preview is flaky right now — infra saw a node restart earlier. pinging infra team to retrigger the preview once runtime confirms.
matt: If runtime default is 10, docs should show an explicit example (and call out the mismatch). I can review once Kevin confirms. Also we might want a short migration note in the release notes.
kevin: Confirmed — runtime default for continuous batching `batch_timeout_ms` was changed to 10 in commit 9f3b2a on 2026-02-28 (perf rollout). SDK default stayed at 5 because of a compatibility flag. I'll open a tiny runtime API doc note (internal) and link it here.
sophia: Thanks — would you rather we (A) update the docs example to explicitly set `batch_timeout_ms: 10` and call out the discrepancy, then merge docs now and follow up with runtime landing a compatibility change, or (B) hold docs until SDK/runtime defaults are aligned?
matt: Given the release window (~24h), option A seems safest: make the example explicit and add a migration callout. We should mark the PR with a follow-up runtime issue and an owner. I'll be reviewer and will sign off after CI preview is green.
anya: retriggering preview now — /preview
docs-ci-bot: preview queued (job 9843). link: https://ci.internal/preview/9843
anya: infra fixed the render worker config, should be stable now.
docs-ci-bot: preview succeeded — rendering and linkcheck passed. artifacts: https://ci.internal/preview/9843/artifacts
sophia: Updated the snippet to explicitly set `batch_timeout_ms: 10` and added a short migration note under "Known defaults". snippet:
```
// JS SDK
client.createInference({
  model: "open-llama-7b",
  batch_timeout_ms: 10
})
```
Link to PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5234
matt: Quick scan — looks good. migration note reads clear. LGTM from docs side, will approve in GitHub. :+1:
sophia: Approved and merging after a 15-minute hold to watch telemetry. Will file follow-up runtime issue for aligning SDK default: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/issues/762
kevin: I will pick up the runtime side for the follow-up and coordinate with SDK owners. Thanks for handling the doc-first approach.
sophia: Thanks all! merging now. :shipit:
